name: @w6w-apps/paperform
description: Manage Paperform forms, fields, submissions and webhooks over the Paperform API v1.

w6w.longDescription:
Paperform is a document-style form and survey builder — payments, e-signature requests, quizzes and multi-step workflows presented as one continuous page rather than a grid of boxes. This app covers the Paperform API v1's form/submission lifecycle: list and read forms, read and update their fields, list, read and delete full and partial (in-progress, not-yet-submitted) submissions, manage per-form webhooks, and read spaces (the folders forms are organised into).

A form's fields and a submission's answers are both free-form — Paperform's own field catalog spans two dozen types (text, choices, products, signature, calculations, matrix, and more), each with a different options shape — so this app exposes a field update and a submission's answer data as JSON matching Paperform's own wire shape, rather than a generated per-type form that would drift out of sync with it.

Separately, Paperform also sells Papersign, a standalone e-signature product with its own section of this same API (`/papersign/*`). It is not covered here — see the README for why.
